mapper.sql: m.id, m.client_msg_id AS clientMsgId, m.conversation_id AS conversationId, m.sender_id AS senderId, u.username AS senderUsername, u.nickname AS senderNickname, u.avatar AS senderAvatar, m.content, m.msg_type AS msgType, m.created_at AS createdAt, m.recalled_at AS recalledAt, m.quote_message_id AS quoteMessageId, q.sender_id AS quoteSenderId, COALESCE(qu.nickname, qu.username) AS quoteSenderName, q.content AS quoteContent, q.msg_type AS quoteMsgType, CASE WHEN q.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (q.recalled_at IS NOT NULL) END AS quoteRecalled
FROM im_message m LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = m.sender_id LEFT JOIN im_message q ON q.id = m.quote_message_id LEFT JOIN sys_user qu ON qu.id = q.sender_id
mapper.select: SELECT id, client_msg_id, conversation_id, sender_id, content, msg_type, created_at, recalled_at, quote_message_id FROM im_message WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT
WHERE m.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM im_message_hidden h WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} AND h.message_id = m.id ) ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_message_hidden (user_id, message_id, conversation_id, hidden_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{messageId}, #{conversationId}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (user_id, message_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO im_message (client_msg_id, conversation_id, sender_id, content, msg_type, created_at, quote_message_id) VALUES (#{clientMsgId}, #{conversationId}, #{senderId}, #{content}, #{msgType}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, NOW()), #{quoteMessageId})
